name: eset-protect-mcp
description: Every ESET Connect endpoint in one binary, plus per-customer health, exposure and QBR reports built from a local mirror of your MSP tree.

eset_protect_username.title: ESET Connect API user (email)
eset_protect_username.description: Sets ESET_PROTECT_USERNAME, the email of a dedicated API user with ESET Connect access (create it in ESET PROTECT Hub, ESET Business Account or ESET MSP Administrator 2).

eset_protect_password.title: ESET Connect API user password
eset_protect_password.description: Sets ESET_PROTECT_PASSWORD. The server exchanges the email and password for a one-hour bearer token and renews it; the password is only sent to the ESET Connect token endpoint.

eset_protect_region.title: ESET data center
eset_protect_region.description: Sets ESET_PROTECT_REGION, the tenant's data center: eu, de, us, ca or jpn (default eu).

eset_protect_token.title: Pre-minted bearer token
eset_protect_token.description: Leave blank. A bearer token minted elsewhere (it expires after one hour); when set it is used instead of the email and password.

eset_protect_base_url.title: Base URL override
eset_protect_base_url.description: Leave blank: every call goes to the regional ESET Connect hosts. Set only to route all calls through a proxy or test server; the bearer token is sent to that host.

eset_protect_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
eset_protect_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends. Leave blank to use the CLI's own.

eset_protect_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only MCP server
eset_protect_mcp_read_only.description: Set to exactly 1 so the MCP server exposes only read tools and eset-protect_execute refuses every non-GET endpoint (including the few POST reads). Leave blank for full access.

eset_protect_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
eset_protect_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote or hosted deployment). Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile
printing_press_client_profile.description: Not enforced by this connector: there are no tenant-gated client profiles, so a value here does not limit which customers a call can reach. Leave blank. To limit what an agent can do, give the API user a narrower ESET role or turn on the read-only MCP server.
